notes: Source job identities and endpoint targets were captured from read-only live Lovable cron inspection. Raw cron command bodies are intentionally not stored because they may embed credentials. Source schedules must be re-captured from a validated export or successful read-only query before any source job is approved for target activation. Recovered live source code is evidence, not approved target code: truth-floor/auth/portability review is required before activate/replace decisions.

jobs.evidence_note: Live source implementation recovered. Depends on missing shared cron-guard/cron-batch/outcome-direction helpers and older cron secret conventions. Its prediction_accuracy_score is a deterministic outcome-fit score; do not treat it as calibrated probability without explicit semantics/evaluation.

Live source implementation is materially safer than historical random-outcome calibration: it restricts calibration input to prospective evaluated outcomes. Still depends on missing cron helpers, calibrates confidence against derived prediction_accuracy_score, and optionally calls the Lovable AI gateway. Requires provider-neutral/auth/epistemic hardening before port.

Live health-check probes DB/Auth/Storage, cron staleness/failures and execution-engine error rate. Canonical enterprise-health-check has stronger hardened auth/truth labels but does not yet preserve all of this coverage; cron-enterprise-health adds cleanup/heartbeat behavior but is not a complete equivalent. Do not mark replaced yet.
Command preview showed a CTE beginning with intelligence-brief-generator; full multi-call behavior must be recovered before classification.

Live engine owns fusion clusters, pressure models, conflict detection, attention budgets, memory and suppression. It also manufactures confidence defaults/composites (including fallback confidence values and historical reliability defaults). Canonical narrative-clustering is safer but functionally narrower and not an equivalent replacement.

Live graph builder creates useful deterministic operational nodes/edges but defaults missing confidence, labels heuristic relationships causal, stamps inferred links last_validated_at=now, and assigns hardcoded propagation parameters. Preserve functionality only after separating deterministic association from observed/verified relation and leaving unmeasured confidence null.

Live topology code defaults missing edge strength/confidence, derives confidence-like scores from graph structure, and sets historical_accuracy=50 placeholder before thresholding governance events. Do not reactivate unchanged.

Live attention compressor is primarily deterministic ranking/dedup/persona budgeting, but its priority and summaries consume graph_topology_scores produced by the unsafe upstream topology semantics. Port only after the graph score contract is truth-floor hardened.

Canonical implementation now preserves recurrence evidence while writing historical_effectiveness=NULL, effectiveness_semantics=unmeasured_no_outcome_linkage, pattern_semantics=deterministic_recurrence_pattern_not_causal_inference, and uses requireAdminOrTrustedWorker. Operational graph truth-floor migration removes the legacy effectiveness default. No target schedule or writer activation has been added; live schedule capture and cutover approval remain required.
